# Gianni Perugini

> Official portfolio and digital art store of Gianni Perugini, a creative director and digital media specialist working across digital art, photography, video and motion, and interface design.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://gianniperugini.com/): One-screen cinematic entrance to Gianni Perugini's work.
- [Glace Noire Store](https://gianniperugini.com/archive.html): Watermarked previews, current USD pricing, personal-use collections, complete archives, and Payhip purchase links.
- [Portfolio](https://gianniperugini.com/projects.html): Wake the Night, Built in the Cold, Wet Neon Noir, Urban Noir, Ice Reveal, IceDraft Pool, Draft lottery, Ground Control Dashboard, Glace Noire, Rent360, and the Digital Art Store.
- [Wake the Night](https://gianniperugini.com/wake-the-night.html): Eight-second GLACE NOIRE film. A pale hand presses the raven, and cold smoke is released.
- [Built in the Cold](https://gianniperugini.com/gym.html): Glace Noire gym theme. Three 8-second films and three stills.
- [Wet Neon Noir](https://gianniperugini.com/wet-neon-noir.html): Still-to-motion cut from the Wet Neon Noir series. Sequence Alley Pulse → Alley Car → Glass Rain. 12.75s, 1920×1080, 24fps.
- [Urban Noir](https://gianniperugini.com/urban-noir.html): Still-to-motion cut from the Urban Noir series.
- [Ice Reveal](https://gianniperugini.com/ice-reveal.html): Still-to-motion cut from the Glace Noire /art hero.
- [How I work with AI](https://gianniperugini.com/how-i-work-with-ai.html): Models in use, where AI enters, what stays hand-finished, and the generation-log format kept for reproducibility. Linked from About, not from the project grid.
- [IceDraft Pool](https://icedraft.gianniperugini.com): Private hockey fantasy leagues with live snake drafts, invite codes, and automatic standings.
- [Draft lottery](https://gianniperugini.com/lottery/): The live draw. Not part of IceDraft; it lives on gianniperugini.com/lottery/.
- [Ground Control Dashboard](https://gianniperugini.com/projects.html): Private studio command center shown as a still on the portfolio. It runs locally by design and has no public app URL.
- [Rent360 live concept](https://gianniperugini.com/rent360/): A SaaS landing-page concept. Rent360 is not a real company; all metrics, listings, guests and reviews are invented sample data, and the gallery photography is public domain (CC0).
- [Glace Noire art](https://glacenoire.com/art): Art hub for the Glace Noire brand.
- [Photography](https://gianniperugini.com/photography.html): Selected field and studio photographs. Portfolio gallery only — not Glace Noire Store.
- [About](https://gianniperugini.com/about.html): Professional biography, LinkedIn, and résumé PDF.
- [Contact](https://gianniperugini.com/contact.html): Direct email, inquiry form, LinkedIn, and résumé PDF.
- [Standard Commercial Licence](https://gianniperugini.com/commercial-licence.html): Authoritative commercial licence permissions and restrictions.

## Digital art products

- Individual wallpaper: one artwork in 4K desktop and mobile formats for personal use; $1 USD minimum pay-what-you-want via Payhip from the Glace Noire Store lightbox.
- Collection: 12 mobile wallpapers from $4 USD, 12 4K desktop wallpapers from $4 USD, or all 24 files from $6 USD.
- Complete personal archive: 14 collections; mobile or desktop from $19 USD, or both formats from $29 USD.
- Complete commercial archive: 14 collections and 336 files from $79 USD under the Standard Commercial Licence.
- Prices marked with a plus sign are minimum pay-what-you-want prices. Buyers may enter a higher amount to support the artist.

## Important facts

- Products are digital downloads; no physical item is shipped.
- Desktop wallpapers are 3840 × 2160 JPG files.
- Mobile wallpapers are 1440 × 2560 JPG files and may use compositions different from the desktop versions.
- The website shows watermarked sales previews. Purchased download files are governed by the licence included with the applicable product.
- Payhip handles checkout and digital delivery.

For product availability, pricing, and licence terms, use the official pages linked above as the authoritative source.
